title: Gated launch playbook: channel owners rota, release-notes gating and webinar schedule
creator: Ava Nakamura
description: Coordinate a gated announcement for the March release that combines: staged release-notes gating, a blog post with an embargo window, localized social cadences, and a product webinar run-of-show. Goal is a single integrated playbook that reduces PR/ops confusion and ensures the staged rollout can be paused per-region. Deliverables: channel ownership rota, embargoed asset checklist, localized copy table, webinar dry-run schedule, monitoring dashboard links, and an escalation path if we hit regressions during canary rollouts.

channel_playbook: Blog: Draft on Drive -> editorial review -> schedule CMS publish with embargo timestamp. Include changelog excerpt + developer quote. Owner: Priya Reddy.
Email: 2-stage send (beta users then general). Beta send syndication includes opt-in list and clear rollback messaging. Use subject lines A/B test. Owner: Priya Reddy.
Social: Localized short copy per locale; staggered tweets/posts aligned to embargo + region windows. Social owner coordinates with Design for hero assets. Owner: Sofia Patel.
Webinar: 45-minute product walkthrough + 15-minute Q&A. Host list, run-of-show, and rehearsal recordings stored in Drive. Attendee follow-up email includes link to release notes. Owner: Priya Reddy.
Docs/Dev: Release notes published in docs site after blog live; dev-focused changelog snippet included in blog. Owner: Marco Alvarez.

Channel gating: Each channel has a single boolean 'release_allowed' controlled by PM Operations and wired to canary gating playbook. If canary fails, channel_messages include standardized rollback copy. Owner: Daniel Brooks.
Monitoring & Alerts: Dashboard streams canary error-rate, latency P50/P95, and percentage of traffic on new rollout. Alerts sent to #prod-release and on-call ENG. Owner: Liam Chen.

risks_and_mitigations: Localization delays (JA/ES): Mitigation - staggered social publishes per region; email to localized customers only after localized copy is available.
Canary regression during rollout: Mitigation - immediate pause of 'release_allowed' flag, send rollback template to channels, and trigger incident bridge per ENG runbook.
Embargo leak: Mitigation - restrict Drive folder to explicit list, watermark drafts, and limit CMS publish permissions until embargo timestamp.
Speaker cancellation for webinar: Mitigation - pre-record 15-minute segment and prepare moderator backup script.
notes: This ticket focuses on the operational choreography rather than creative copy. Separate DES ticket (DES-1204) owns hero creative iterations; ENG tickets own rollout mechanics. After GA we will run a postmortem and capture lessons in Confluence page linked in assets.
